data.one_liner: Utility to verify generated Dart code is up-to-date during build
data.what_it_does: It runs build_runner and checks for uncommitted changes in generated files. If any differences are found, the test fails.
use_when: You use build_runner to generate code and want to ensure it stays in sync
You want to add a CI check that fails when generated code is stale
You need a quick way to assert clean builds in unit tests
avoid_when: You are not using build_runner or code generation
Your project is not under Git version control
You need a more sophisticated diff or linting tool
strengths: Simple API, just a single test function
Async and works with flutter test
data.setup_notes: Add a test file with `test('ensure_build', expectBuildClean);` and ensure build_runner is set up in pubspec
